close_reason: Clarified: removed redundant third issuer-name check from check_revocation caller; verify_delta_crl_and_collect performs the authoritative check. Updated inline comment to document this.
description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:502 — After the parse-delta-once refactor, both check_revocation and check_revocation_against_anchor now check the delta CRL issuer name before calling verify_delta_crl_and_collect. But verify_delta_crl_and_collect also performs names_match internally as its step 1. So names_match is called twice on the delta CRL issuer per check_revocation invocation. This is harmless but wasteful and the verify_delta_crl_and_collect doc comment no longer accurately describes the function contract (its doc says it does the check; callers also do it). Either the internal check should be removed (with a contract comment that callers are responsible) or the callers should remove their check and rely solely on the helper. Low impact but the doc/contract inconsistency is P3.
title: verify_delta_crl_and_collect performs redundant issuer check after caller already checked
